quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI (09-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In its ECOC 2026 release Coherent listed a technology demonstration (not a shipping product) of a compact 3.2T 2xDR4 pluggable transceiver architecture in an OSFP-size package, with dual 1.6T optical paths. The demonstration incorporates eight 425G PAM4 line-side optical lanes, Coherent Differential EMLs and Coherent photodiodes, which the company said highlights progress toward next-generation 400G-per-lane optical connectivity.
quarterly_data.figure: 3.2T in an OSFP-size package; dual 1.6T optical paths; eight 425G PAM4 line-side optical lanes (demonstration)

quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI (09-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: For DCI and scale-across, Coherent said it would showcase at ECOC 2026 its LS200 full C-band pluggable optical line system for datacenter interconnect and transport, a compact architecture that brings pluggable line-system functionality closer to the router or switch while supporting flexible point-to-point optical transport. Among new products and emerging technologies it also listed a Pluggable Optical Line System (POLS): a full C-band optical line system with a high-power, variable-gain amplifier in a compact QSFP form factor, designed for 800G ZR/ZR+ digital coherent optics, supporting up to 32 DWDM wavelengths over a single fiber pair and carrying up to 25.6Tbps across links from 2km to 200km.
quarterly_data.figure: POLS: QSFP form factor; for 800G ZR/ZR+; up to 32 DWDM wavelengths over a single fiber pair; up to 25.6Tbps; links from 2km to 200km

quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI (09-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Coherent named new optical-component products for CPO and external laser sources shown at ECOC 2026: FlexConnect, a detachable fiber array unit connector for CPO designed to simplify assembly and maintenance, with repeatable plug-unplug performance, interchangeability and an epoxy-free optical path compatible with high-power lasers; OptiAlign, a high-precision fiber array unit for CPO supporting precise pitch control and high fiber-channel counts, combining an internally developed V-groove with customized fiber dimensions; OptiFocus, a two-in-one coupling lens design for ELS intended to simplify optical assembly with high coupling efficiency; FiberPack, a passive fiber assembly kit for scale-up and scale-out architectures integrating fiber attach, micro-lens, tray and termination technologies; and OptiPolar Array X, a multi-channel polarization beam splitter array in a super-compact glass-based form factor for multi-lane systems.

quarterly_data.quarter: Coherent press release: Coherent Showcases Optical Innovations to Scale AI (09-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Coherent said it would participate in OIF interoperability at ECOC 2026 and, separately, demonstrate quantum technologies for networking and encryption with industry partners: with Quside, quantum random number generation for encryption using live quantum entropy alongside Coherent optical connectivity; with CUbIQ, participation in a quantum key distribution demonstration in a compact pluggable architecture (demonstrations only).
